name: Bahía Blanca

queries.query: Bahía Blanca Argentina official cadastral map parcel GIS catastro parcelas municipal
queries.result: First-party discovery found the official Municipio de Bahía Blanca Catastro pages, the municipal map/portal pages, the municipal SITeBB reference, and the Provincia de Buenos Aires ARBA Carto viewer. These establish local and provincial cadastral/map custodians; no safe anonymous parcel feature response was retained.

queries.query: Bahía Blanca Argentina sitio oficial catastro mapa parcelas GIS registro catastral
queries.result: La búsqueda oficial en español encontró el Departamento de Catastro municipal, sus trámites de información catastral, registros gráficos y actualización del estado parcelario, además de la referencia oficial al SITeBB y el visor Carto ARBA. La consulta acotada no produjo una respuesta anónima segura con identidad parcelaria y polígono completo.

registry.custodian: Municipalidad de Bahía Blanca, Departamento de Catastro; provincial cadastral/cartographic context by Agencia de Recaudación de la Provincia de Buenos Aires (ARBA).
registry.service: Municipal SITeBB / Catastro services and the public Carto ARBA viewer.
registry.localCustodianEvidence: The official municipal Catastro page lists parcel/inmueble information, registros gráficos and parcel-state update procedures. An official municipal bulletin describes SITeBB as the territorial information system led by Departamento Catastro and notes public access at a limited information level with restricted expanded information.
registry.scope: Municipal cadastral custody and a provincial public cartographic viewer are evidenced. Current anonymous citywide parcel extraction, schema, and completeness were not established.
registry.nationalOrGeneralAgencyEvidence: ARBA is the Buenos Aires provincial agency and Carto ARBA is general provincial map context; it is not treated as the municipal custodian. The Registro de la Propiedad Inmueble delegation was not used for parcel geometry or titleholder data.

parcelEvidence.reason: The public Carto ARBA viewer loaded anonymously and exposed map/search JavaScript routes, but bounded anonymous requests did not produce a verified safe parcel identity plus unchanged full polygon suitable for retention. No synthetic identity or shifted point was used.
parcelEvidence.qualification: Not admitted as a runtime parcel adapter; serial review required.

researchNotes: The exact WUP point was preserved in latitude/longitude order; no coordinate shift or exact-point parcel-hit inference was made.
Official municipal pages describe parcel information, graphic records and parcel-state procedures; the municipal bulletin identifies SITeBB and its access boundaries.

The current Carto ARBA page was followed to its JavaScript/configuration. It loaded with normal TLS verification and exposed anonymous search routes such as client/getNomencla and client/getPdoPda, but no safe bounded ID-plus-full-polygon response was obtained.
Only safe administrative, service, CRS/schema and geometry metadata were in scope. Owner, address, contact, titleholder, tax/account, deed, registration and personal fields were not requested.
This packet records source research only and is not source integration or runtime admission.
